description: Provisional recipe inputs for software integration. IFCT-coded ingredient values resolve from ifct_lookup.csv; recipe amounts and cooked yields are not yet measured.
notes: All recipe ingredient quantities, cooked yields, and serving weights are draft estimates, not canteen-verified or weighed. Nutrient values for ingredients with an IFCT code come from IFCT 2017 Table 1; ingredients absent from that lookup use explicitly marked provisional overrides. Do not report these dish estimates as validated results.
